topic: Nguyen and Tân's primeness and nonsingularity questions for subgroup-unit Cayley graphs
title: Hamming extensions and a short proof from Mináč et al.'s cycle answering Nguyen and Tân's primeness question

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: Using the cycle example of Mináč, Muller, Nguyen and Tân (2022, Corollary 2.5), we give a short negative answer to Nguyen and Tân's Question 4.17 (arXiv:2508.10348v1, Section 4.3, p. 19): Γ(Z/8Z,{1,−1}) = C₈ is prime, connected and anti-connected, with adjacency nullity two. More generally, C_n has these graph properties for n ≥ 5 and is singular exactly when 4 divides n. Extending Chen's binary polynomial construction with the tensor spectrum described by Sander, we realize every Hamming graph H(d,q) over a prime-power alphabet as a subgroup-unit Cayley graph of a Frobenius group algebra. For d ≥ 2, except (d,q)=(2,2), it is prime and anti-connected; it is singular exactly when q divides d, with nullity binomial(d,d(q−1)/q)(q−1)^(d(q−1)/q). These examples also answer Question 2.20 of arXiv:2603.21239v1 negatively. Finally, a short proof of Hendrickson's duality answers the supercharacter-axiom question in Remark 2.2 of the first source affirmatively.
summary: Earlier cycle and polynomial constructions yield negative answers to the primeness questions. The note supplies a short cycle proof, extends the group-algebra construction to all prime-power Hamming alphabets with exact nullity, and answers the neighboring supercharacter-axiom question using Hendrickson duality.
